candidate_summary.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic
candidate_summary.description: Number of [basic] shares or units, after adjustment for contingently issuable shares or units and other shares or units not deemed outstanding, determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares or units have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

candidate_summary.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
candidate_summary.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

candidate_summary.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities
candidate_summary.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activities, including discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.

candidate_summary.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Diluted
candidate_summary.description: The average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating diluted EPS or earnings per unit (EPU), determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
candidate_summary.description: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

candidate_summary.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment
candidate_summary.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization for physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross
candidate_summary.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

candidate_summary.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
candidate_summary.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

candidate_summary.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Property, Plant and Equipment
candidate_summary.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

candidate_summary.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Outstanding, Basic and Diluted
candidate_summary.description: Average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used in calculating basic and diluted earnings per share (EPS).

candidate_summary.label: Gross Profit
candidate_summary.description: Aggregate revenue less cost of goods and services sold or operating expenses directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

candidate_summary.label: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
candidate_summary.description: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.

candidate_summary.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities, Continuing Operations
candidate_summary.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, excluding discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

candidate_summary.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities, Continuing Operations
candidate_summary.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of investing activities, excluding discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.

candidate_summary.label: Proceeds from Sale of Property, Plant, and Equipment
candidate_summary.description: The cash inflow from the sale of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

candidate_summary.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment
candidate_summary.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, including oil and gas property and timber property.

candidate_summary.label: Revenue, Net (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
candidate_summary.description: Total revenue from sale of goods and services rendered during the reporting period, in the normal course of business, reduced by sales returns and allowances, and sales discounts.

candidate_summary.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets
candidate_summary.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets, including but not limited to property plant and equipment, intangible assets and equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.

candidate_summary.label: Payments to Acquire Productive Assets
candidate_summary.description: The cash outflow for purchases of and capital improvements on property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

candidate_summary.label: Weighted Average Number Diluted Shares Outstanding Adjustment
candidate_summary.description: The sum of dilutive potential common shares or units used in the calculation of the diluted per-share or per-unit computation.

candidate_summary.label: Deferred Tax Assets, Property, Plant and Equipment
candidate_summary.description: Amount before allocation of valuation allowances of deferred tax asset attributable to deductible temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

candidate_summary.label: Sales Revenue, Goods, Net (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
candidate_summary.description: Aggregate revenue during the period from the sale of goods in the normal course of business, after deducting returns, allowances and discounts.

candidate_summary.label: Other Operating Activities, Cash Flow Statement
candidate_summary.description: Other cash or noncash adjustments to reconcile net income to cash provided by (used in) operating activities that are not separately disclosed in the statement of cash flows (for example, cash received or cash paid during the current period for miscellaneous operating activities, net change during the reporting period in other assets or other liabilities).

candidate_summary.label: Proceeds from Sale of Productive Assets
candidate_summary.description: The cash inflow from the sale of property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
candidate_summary.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

candidate_summary.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Property Plant Equipment, Excluding Oil and Gas Property and Timber Property
candidate_summary.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment assets, excluding oil and gas property and timber property.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
candidate_summary.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation and amortization from plant, property, and equipment and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, before Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
candidate_summary.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

candidate_summary.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities, Discontinued Operations
candidate_summary.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of operating activities of discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

candidate_summary.label: Excess Tax Benefit from Share-based Compensation, Operating Activities
candidate_summary.description: Amount of cash outflow for realized tax benefit related to deductible compensation cost reported on the entity's tax return for equity instruments in excess of the compensation cost for those instruments recognized for financial reporting purposes.

candidate_summary.label: Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities, Discontinued Operations
candidate_summary.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) of investing activities of discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.

candidate_summary.label: Sales Revenue, Services, Net (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
candidate_summary.description: Aggregate revenue during the period from services rendered in the normal course of business, after deducting allowances and discounts.

candidate_summary.label: Business Combination, Recognized Identifiable Assets Acquired and Liabilities Assumed, Property, Plant, and Equipment
candidate_summary.description: The amount of property, plant, and equipment recognized as of the acquisition date.

candidate_summary.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares Issued, Basic
candidate_summary.description: This element represents the weighted average total number of shares issued throughout the period including the first (beginning balance outstanding) and last (ending balance outstanding) day of the period before considering any reductions (for instance, shares held in treasury) to arrive at the weighted average number of shares outstanding. Weighted average relates to the portion of time within a reporting period that common shares have been issued and outstanding to the total time in that period. Such concept is used in determining the weighted average number of shares outstanding for purposes of calculating earnings per share (basic).

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Additions
candidate_summary.description: Amount of acquisition of long-lived, physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

candidate_summary.label: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Investing Activities
candidate_summary.description: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as investing activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as operating activities.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Gross
candidate_summary.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of other physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale.

candidate_summary.label: Proceeds from Sales of Business, Affiliate and Productive Assets
candidate_summary.description: Aggregate cash proceeds received from a combination of transactions in which noncurrent assets are sold, which may include the sale of a business, an investment in an affiliate (including an equity method investee), property, plant and equipment and intangible assets. Excludes sales of trading, available-for-sale, and held-to-maturity securities.

candidate_summary.label: Payments for (Proceeds from) Productive Assets
candidate_summary.description: The net cash outflow or inflow from purchases, sales and disposals of property, plant and equipment and other productive assets, including intangibles.

candidate_summary.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant and Equipment
candidate_summary.description: Amount classified as property, plant and equipment attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of.

candidate_summary.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Properties
candidate_summary.description: The difference between the carrying value and the sale price of real estate or properties that were intended to be sold or held for capital appreciation or rental income. This element refers to the gain (loss) included in earnings and not to the cash proceeds of the sale. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

candidate_summary.label: Payments to Acquire Other Property, Plant, and Equipment
candidate_summary.description: Amount of cash outflow from the acquisition of or improvements to long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

candidate_summary.label: Payment for Contingent Consideration Liability, Operating Activities
candidate_summary.description: Amount of cash outflow, not made soon after acquisition date of business combination, to settle contingent consideration liability exceeding amount recognized at acquisition date. Includes, but is not limited to, measurement period adjustment and less amount paid soon after acquisition date.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Disposals
candidate_summary.description: Amount of divestiture of long-lived, physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

candidate_summary.label: Adjustments to Reconcile Net Income (Loss) to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
candidate_summary.description: The sum of adjustments which are added to or deducted from net income or loss, including the portion attributable to noncontrolling interest, to reflect cash provided by or used in operating activities, in accordance with the indirect cash flow method.

candidate_summary.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant and Equipment, Noncurrent
candidate_summary.description: Amount classified as property, plant and equipment attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of after one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

candidate_summary.label: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Cash for Operating Activities
candidate_summary.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) associated with funds that are not available for withdrawal or use (such as funds held in escrow) and are associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities. This may include cash restricted for regulatory purposes.

candidate_summary.label: Proceeds from Insurance Settlement, Operating Activities
candidate_summary.description: Amount of cash inflow for proceeds from settlement of insurance claim, classified as operating activities. Excludes insurance settlement classified as investing activities.

candidate_summary.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Property, Plant, and Equipment
candidate_summary.description: Amount of cash inflow for the sale of long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

candidate_summary.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Other Finite-Lived Assets
candidate_summary.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from long-lived assets other than property, plant, and equipment.

candidate_summary.label: Disposal Group, Including Discontinued Operation, Property, Plant and Equipment, Current
candidate_summary.description: Amount classified as property, plant and equipment attributable to disposal group held for sale or disposed of, expected to be disposed of within one year or the normal operating cycle, if longer.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Transfers and Changes
candidate_summary.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale, from reclassification, impairment, donation, or changes classified as other. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

candidate_summary.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
candidate_summary.description: Period end amount of total net PPE.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Net
candidate_summary.description: Amount after depreciation of long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

candidate_summary.label: Pro Forma Weighted Average Shares Outstanding, Diluted
candidate_summary.description: The weighted average number of shares or units and dilutive common stock or unit equivalents outstanding in the calculation of proforma diluted earnings per share (earnings per unit), which is commonly presented in initial public offerings based on the terms of the offering.

candidate_summary.label: Regulated and Unregulated Operating Revenue
candidate_summary.description: The total amount of operating revenues recognized during the period.

candidate_summary.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Accumulated Depreciation
candidate_summary.description: Period end book value of accumulated depreciation on property, plant and equipment (PPE) that is owned by the regulated operations of the public utility.

candidate_summary.label: Adjustments, Noncash Items, to Reconcile Net Income (Loss) to Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
candidate_summary.description: The aggregate amount of adjustments to net income or loss necessary to remove the effects of all items whose cash effects are investing or financing cash flows. The aggregate amount also includes all noncash expenses and income items which reduce or increase net income and are thus added back or deducted when calculating cash provided by or used in operating activities.

candidate_summary.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Plant in Service
candidate_summary.description: Period end amount of total gross PPE.

candidate_summary.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Construction Work in Progress
candidate_summary.description: Period end amount of construction work in progress in public utility.

candidate_summary.label: Sales Revenue, Goods, Gross (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
candidate_summary.description: Aggregate revenue during the period from sale of goods in the normal course of business, before deducting returns, allowances and discounts.

candidate_summary.label: Depreciation and Amortization, Discontinued Operations
candidate_summary.description: Amount of deprecation and amortization expense attributable to property, plant and equipment and intangible assets of discontinued operations.

candidate_summary.label: Weighted Average Basic Shares Outstanding, Pro Forma
candidate_summary.description: The weighted average number of shares (units) outstanding in the calculation of pro forma basic earnings per share (earnings per unit), which is commonly presented in initial public offerings based on the terms of the offering.

candidate_summary.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant and Equipment, Period Increase (Decrease)
candidate_summary.description: Amount of increase (decrease) in accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of property, plant and equipment.

candidate_summary.label: Electric Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
candidate_summary.description: The aggregate revenue, whether regulated or unregulated, derived from the generation, transmission and distribution of electricity.

candidate_summary.label: Capital Expenditure, Discontinued Operations
candidate_summary.description: Amount of capital expenditure attributable to discontinued operations.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Other, Accumulated Depreciation
candidate_summary.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation of long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale, classified as other.

candidate_summary.label: Nonoperating Gains (Losses)
candidate_summary.description: The aggregate amount of gains or losses resulting from nonoperating activities (for example, interest and dividend revenue, property, plant and equipment impairment loss, and so forth).

candidate_summary.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Other Property, Plant and Equipment
candidate_summary.description: Period end book value of other property, plant and equipment (PPE) owned (but not classified elsewhere) by the public utility.

candidate_summary.label: Accumulated Capitalized Interest Costs
candidate_summary.description: Amount of accumulated interest costs capitalized as part of property, plant and equipment cost basis.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Fair Value Disclosure
candidate_summary.description: Fair value portion of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

candidate_summary.label: Business Acquisition, Revenue Reported by Acquired Entity for Last Annual Period
candidate_summary.description: Total revenue reported by the acquired entity for its previous full fiscal year before the business acquisition.

candidate_summary.label: Business Combination, Provisional Information, Initial Accounting Incomplete, Adjustment, Property, Plant, and Equipment
candidate_summary.description: This element represents the amount of any measurement period adjustment (as defined) realized during the reporting period to property, plant, and equipment acquired in connection with a business combination for which the initial accounting was incomplete.

candidate_summary.label: Assets, Noncurrent, Other than Noncurrent Investments and Property, Plant and Equipment
candidate_summary.description: Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets, excluding property, plant, and equipment and other property and investments, that are expected to be realized in cash, sold or consumed after one year or beyond the normal operating cycle, if longer. Alternate captions include Total Deferred Charges and Other Assets.

candidate_summary.label: Results of Operations, Revenue from Oil and Gas Producing Activities
candidate_summary.description: Total revenues from oil and gas producing activities.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross, Period Increase (Decrease)
candidate_summary.description: Amount of increase (decrease) of long-lived, physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

candidate_summary.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Sale or Disposal of Property, Plant and Equipment
candidate_summary.description: Amount of decrease in accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization as a result of sale or disposal of property, plant and equipment.

candidate_summary.label: Weighted Average Number of Shares, Contingently Issuable
candidate_summary.description: Shares issuable for little or no cash consideration upon the satisfaction of certain conditions (contingently issuable shares) are considered outstanding common shares and included in the computation of basic Earnings Per Share as of the date that all necessary conditions have been satisfied (in essence, when issuance of the shares is no longer contingent). Outstanding common shares that are contingently returnable (that is, subject to recall) are treated in the same manner as contingently issuable shares. Contingently issuable shares include shares that (a) will be issued in the future upon the satisfaction of specified conditions, (b) have been placed in escrow and all or part must be returned if specified conditions are not met, or (c) have been issued but the holder must return all or part if specified conditions are not met. The number of contingently issuable shares is determined by relating the portion of time within a reporting period that these shares have been outstanding to the total time in that period.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Owned, Accumulated Depreciation
candidate_summary.description: The cumulative amount of depreciation (related to long-lived, depreciable flight assets owned by the entity and used in the entity's principle business operations and capitalized assets classified as property, plant and equipment that are owned by the entity) that has been recognized in the income statement.

candidate_summary.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Disclosure of Composite Depreciation Rate for Plants in Service
candidate_summary.description: Composite depreciation rate for public utility plants in service.

candidate_summary.label: Capital Leases, Lessee Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Property, Plant, and Equipment Other, Accumulated Depreciation
candidate_summary.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation on leased long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale meeting the criteria for capitalization, classified as other.

candidate_summary.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment, Excluding Capital Leased Assets
candidate_summary.description: Cumulative amount of depreciation, depletion and amortization (related to property, plant and equipment, but not including land or leased assets).

candidate_summary.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Generation or Processing
candidate_summary.description: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to generation or processing owned by public utility.

candidate_summary.label: Repayments of Long-term Loans from Vendors
candidate_summary.description: Cash outflows under financing arrangements with vendors (seller-financed debt), which had a maturity date at inception of more than one year (or more than one operating cycle, if longer); such debt may have arisen from purchases of property, plant and equipment or other productive assets.

candidate_summary.label: Oil and Gas Revenue (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
candidate_summary.description: Aggregate revenue during the period related to oil and gas business activities.

candidate_summary.label: Proceeds from Sale of Other Assets
candidate_summary.description: Amount of cash inflow from the sale of other assets as part of operating activities.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net, Excluding Capital Leased Assets
candidate_summary.description: Amount, net of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization, of long-lived physical assets excluding assets held under lease agreements used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

candidate_summary.label: Cost of Goods Sold, Depreciation and Amortization (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
candidate_summary.description: Depreciation of property, plant and equipment directly related to goods produced and sold during the reporting period.

candidate_summary.label: Revenue Mineral Sales (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
candidate_summary.description: Aggregate revenue from the sale of minerals and related products, and from rendering services such as exploration, development, mining, processing and providing mining support activities.

candidate_summary.label: Proceeds from Collection of Lease Receivables
candidate_summary.description: The cash inflow associated with the collection of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

candidate_summary.label: Proceeds from Other Operating Activities
candidate_summary.description: Amount of cash inflow from operating activities classified as other.

candidate_summary.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Common
candidate_summary.description: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to regulated assets common to business units.

candidate_summary.label: Payments for Other Operating Activities
candidate_summary.description: Amount of cash outflow for operating activities classified as other.

candidate_summary.label: Cost of Services, Depreciation and Amortization (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
candidate_summary.description: Depreciation of property, plant and equipment directly related to services rendered by an entity during the reporting period.

candidate_summary.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Distribution
candidate_summary.description: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to utility distribution.

candidate_summary.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Transmission
candidate_summary.description: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to utility transmission owned by public utility.

candidate_summary.label: Capital Leases, Lessee Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Other Property, Plant, and Equipment, Gross
candidate_summary.description: Amount before depreciation of leased long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale meeting the criteria for capitalization, classified as other.

candidate_summary.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Transmission and Distribution
candidate_summary.description: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to transmission and distribution owned by public utility.

candidate_summary.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Reclassifications from Property, Plant and Equipment
candidate_summary.description: Amount of decrease in accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization as a result of reclassifications from property, plant and equipment.

candidate_summary.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Equipment
candidate_summary.description: Period end book value of equipment owned (but not classified elsewhere) by the public utility.

candidate_summary.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Land
candidate_summary.description: Period end book value of land owned by the public utility.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross, Excluding Capital Leased Assets
candidate_summary.description: Gross amount of long-lived physical assets excluding assets held under lease agreements used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

candidate_summary.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Present Value of Regulated Asset for Plant Abandonment
candidate_summary.description: The present value amount of future cost recoveries that are probable and estimable related to plant abandonment's for regulated industries.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Salvage Value
candidate_summary.description: The estimated or actual value of the asset at the end of its useful life or when it is no longer serviceable (cannot be used for its original purpose).

candidate_summary.label: Gain (Loss) on Sale of Loans and Leases
candidate_summary.description: The gains (losses) included in earnings that represent the difference between the sale price and the carrying value of loans and leases that were sold during the reporting period. This element refers to the gain (loss) and not to the cash proceeds of the sales. This element is a noncash adjustment to net income when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Additions
candidate_summary.description: Amount of acquisition of long-lived, physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, furniture and fixtures, and computer equipment.

candidate_summary.label: Payments to Acquire Property, Plant, and Equipment
candidate_summary.description: The cash outflow associated with the acquisition of long-lived, physical assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale; includes cash outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Net
candidate_summary.description: Amount after accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

candidate_summary.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Investing Activities
candidate_summary.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activities, including discontinued operations. Investing activity cash flows include making and collecting loans and acquiring and disposing of debt or equity instruments and property, plant, and equipment and other productive assets.

candidate_summary.label: Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities
candidate_summary.description: Amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities, including discontinued operations. Operating activity cash flows include transactions, adjustments, and changes in value not defined as investing or financing activities.

candidate_summary.label: Nuclear Fuel, Net of Amortization
candidate_summary.description: The carrying amount as of the balance sheet of nuclear fuel held as property plant and equipment. This amount is net of amortization based on the energy produced over the life of the fuel.

candidate_summary.label: Gain (Loss) on Disposition of Assets
candidate_summary.description: Amount of gain (loss) on sale or disposal of assets, including but not limited to property plant and equipment, intangible assets and equity in securities of subsidiaries or equity method investee.

candidate_summary.label: Proceeds from Sale of Productive Assets
candidate_summary.description: The cash inflow from the sale of property, plant and equipment (capital expenditures), software, and other intangible assets.

candidate_summary.label: Real Estate Revenue, Net (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
candidate_summary.description: The aggregate revenue from real estate operations during the reporting period.

candidate_summary.label: Capital Expenditures Incurred but Not yet Paid
candidate_summary.description: Future cash outflow to pay for purchases of fixed assets that have occurred.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Number of Aircraft Sold
candidate_summary.description: The number of aircraft sold by the entity during the period.

candidate_summary.label: Time Share Costs (Deprecated 2018-01-31)
candidate_summary.description: The costs associated with a property whose ownership is held by a number of people, each with a right of possession for a specified time interval. Time-Sharing is most commonly applied to resort and vacation properties; also known as Vacation Interest. The costs include the costs to build or acquire a vacation project, the estimated cost needed to complete a project under construction, the total revenues expected to be earned on a project, and the projected revenues relating to the recovered purchase on future cancelled sales.

candidate_summary.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Acquisition Adjustments
candidate_summary.description: Amount of acquisition adjustments included in property, plant and equipment (PPE) for utilities.

candidate_summary.label: Deferred Tax Liabilities, Property, Plant and Equipment
candidate_summary.description: Amount of deferred tax liability attributable to taxable temporary differences from property, plant, and equipment.

candidate_summary.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Fuel
candidate_summary.description: Period end amount of property, plant and equipment (PPE) related to fuels owned by the public utility.

candidate_summary.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Amount of Acquisition Adjustments, Related Accumulated Depreciation
candidate_summary.description: Amount of increase (decrease) for acquisition adjustments on accumulated depreciation included in long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale for utilities.

candidate_summary.label: Weighted Average Number Basic Shares Outstanding Adjustment, Pro Forma
candidate_summary.description: Adjustment to the weighted average number of basic shares outstanding to convert this to a pro forma presentation.

candidate_summary.label: Accumulated Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization, Property, Plant, and Equipment
candidate_summary.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization for physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant and Equipment, Gross
candidate_summary.description: Amount before accumulated depreciation, depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business and not intended for resale. Examples include, but are not limited to, land, buildings, machinery and equipment, office equipment, and furniture and fixtures.

candidate_summary.label: Public Utilities, Property, Plant and Equipment, Vehicles
candidate_summary.description: Period end book value of vehicles owned by the public utility.

candidate_summary.label: Capital Leases, Lessee Balance Sheet, Assets by Major Class, Other Property, Plant, and Equipment, Net
candidate_summary.description: Amount after depreciation of leased long-lived, physical assets used to produce goods and services and not intended for resale meeting the criteria for capitalization, classified as other.

candidate_summary.label: Reimbursement from Limited Partnership Investment
candidate_summary.description: A payment from an investee, in which the investment basis has previously been reduced to zero. This amount reduces net cash used in operating activities.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
candidate_summary.description: Amount of accumulated depreciation and amortization from plant, property, and equipment and right-of-use asset from finance lease.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, after Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
candidate_summary.description: Amount, after accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment and Finance Lease Right-of-Use Asset, before Accumulated Depreciation and Amortization
candidate_summary.description: Amount, before accumulated depreciation and amortization, of property, plant, and equipment and finance lease right-of-use asset.

candidate_summary.label: Increase (Decrease) in Restricted Cash for Operating Activities
candidate_summary.description: The net cash inflow or outflow for the increase (decrease) associated with funds that are not available for withdrawal or use (such as funds held in escrow) and are associated with underlying transactions that are classified as operating activities. This may include cash restricted for regulatory purposes.

candidate_summary.label: Proceeds from Sale of Lease Receivables
candidate_summary.description: The cash inflow associated with the sale of receivables arising from the lease of real estate, equipment or other fixed assets for a specified time in exchange for payment, usually in the form of rent; excludes proceeds from sales-type lease transactions, which are classified as operating activities.

candidate_summary.label: Property, Plant, and Equipment, Owned, Net
candidate_summary.description: The net amount of long-lived, depreciable flight assets owned by the entity and used in the entity's principle business operations (owned aircraft and capitalized improvements) and capitalized assets classified as property, plant and equipment that are owned by the entity. Excludes assets subject to a capital lease.

note: Discovery only. CAPEX_EXACT_CANDIDATE still requires manual semantic approval before any fact is used.
